scope: Android 15 ARM64 ordinary-app Linux/Node, synthetic secret handling, network prerequisites and original DSH native prerequisites. Explicit foreground instrumentation. Intermediate engineering evidence, not an end-to-end Agent or background-reliability claim.
historical_baseline: android15-linux-progress.json retains the separate earlier 69/69 build and historical failures; these counts are not added together.

runs.failure: linux_node_network_http_keepalive: guest exit 1, ERR_ASSERTION, observed two server connections where exactly one was required; the earlier success-looking stdout did not override the failed exit. Last unsupported syscall was 207. Subsequent complete runs passed the same workflow.

linux_dsh_native_flock_conflict_release: original guest Node failed at fsync with ENOSYS, last unsupported AArch64 syscall 82; the full native-lock workflow did not pass this round. The subsequent complete run passed.

validated.linux_node_secret_output_events: Original Linux Node received synchronous copies of synthetic secretEnv entries. A two-phase guest/manager exchange split exact and JSON-escaped secret text across output reads. Live stdout/stderr, decoded byte events and durable results contained the expected replacements while preserving the HTTP 401 diagnostic; request.env stayed public, secret metadata contained only the sorted names, and a short secret overlapping 'exited'/'linux-jit' did not corrupt typed status.
validated.linux_node_secret_cancel_cleanup: Synthetic secret output stayed filtered through cancellation; no input bytes were accepted or written, four cleanup barriers completed and a later ordinary execution reused the project.
validated.linux_node_network: Default IP admission denied; explicitly enabled loopback TCP transferred 393221 verified bytes with half-close, two HTTP POSTs reused one connection, refused-connect errno and post-cancel listener cleanup/reuse passed. This run did not validate outbound DNS, UDP or public TLS.
validated.linux_dsh_profile_install_bundle: Official guest Node installed 24424 files / 367519382 bytes from the verified 94883559-byte SDK bundle. This used original package contents, not a host Harness run.
validated.linux_dsh_sdk: Unmodified sdk-minimal EOF boot and initialize -> response -> shutdown passed. Server deepseek-harness-sdk-runtime/0.0.1; 206 input bytes; zero protocol notifications; exit zero and four barriers. No model, prompt, Agent tool, Web or external request.
validated.linux_dsh_native_process_report: Original Node process.report.getReport returned the selected Linux ARM64/glibc facts, including glibc 2.36. The environment/full report was not emitted.
validated.linux_dsh_native_flock_conflict_release: Original published system.node async flock succeeded twice on one open description, conflicted with an independent open (EAGAIN/EWOULDBLOCK), released locks on close and passed the workflow's real write/sync and independent artifact check. This is not a multi-process lock test.

separate_device_mechanism_probe.scope: Separate isolated packaged-runner capability probe measured host fork/clone/re-exec, per-thread seccomp, parent-death cleanup and waitpid. Not included in 41 app cases. No guest continuation/TLS, general Linux fork/exec/wait, PTY/controlling terminal or cross-UID signalling tested.

node_secret_workflow_compile.scope: Six-source strict compilation only; the later device evidence is identified separately above

credential_bridge_interop.scope: Actual host Node/JVM synthetic localhost handshake, authenticated transfer, dedicated synthetic sender, substitution/tamper/truncation rejection. No Android peer UID or ADB bridge validation yet.

limits: No real credential was sent via the bridge and no model request was made in the evidence above. The bridge was not part of the third APK build.
Synthetic known-value output redaction cannot prevent arbitrary guest transformations, writes to guest files or disclosure by untrusted programs.
Production fork/exec/PTY/shell workflows and the real original DSH model -> tools -> artifact -> durable session resume loop are not established by these runs.
The two auxiliary APKs were kept installed under the existing user preference. This record does not claim a cleanup diagnostic or change the historical baseline.
